verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਸਿਖਣਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਤਿਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: gursikhee dhaa sikhanaa sabadh surat satisa(n)gat sikhai|

en.bdb: To learn about Sikh-life, one ought to merge one's consciousness in the Word in the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਲਿਖਣਾ ਗੁਰ ਬਾਣੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਮਝੈ ਲਿਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: gursikhee dhaa likhanaa gur baanee sun samajhai likhai|

en.bdb: Writing about Sikh life is to go on listening, understanding and continuously writing.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਸਿਮਰਣੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਕੋਲੂ ਰਸੁ ਇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: gursikhee dhaa simarano satigur ma(n)t koloo ras ikhai|

en.bdb: Simran, meditation in Sikh life is learning the Guru-mantra (Vahiguru) which is sweet like sugarcane juice.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਵਰਤਮਾਨੁ ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਬਿਰਿਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: gursikhee dhaa varatamaan cha(n)dhan vaas nivaas birikhai|

en.bdb: The spirit of the Sikhism is like fragrance residing in sandalwood trees.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਬੁਝਣਾ ਬੁਝਿ ਅਬੁਝਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲੈ ਭਿਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: gursikhee dhaa bujhanaa bujh abujh hovai lai bhikhai|

en.bdb: The understanding of a Sikh of the Guru consists in the fact that even after having received the gifted alms (of nom) and being fully knowledgeable, he considered himself as ignorant.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਸਰਿਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh sun naam dhaan isanaan sarikhai|

en.bdb: The Sikh of the Guru, in the holy congregation listens to the word of the Guru and practises meditation, charity and ablution,
And thus goes across the past present to a new the future.
